articles.summary: Diageo plc subsidiary, United Spirits Limited (USL), has announced it has entered into definitive agreements for the sale of its 100% equity stake in Royal Challengers Sports Private Limited (RCSPL) to a consortium comprising Aditya Birla Group (“ABG”), The Times of India Group (“Times”), Bolt Ventures (“Bolt”), and Blackstone’s perpetual private equity strategy, BXPE ("Blackstone") for a total consideration of INR 166.6 billion.
